data.narrative:
Maritime Fusion is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Justin Cohen and Jason Kaufmann that has raised $4.5M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector encompasses 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lineage Inc., LNZA), including notable private companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Given the early stage and heterogeneity within the Climate & Energy sector, only the stage-progression method proved applicable. This approach uses total capital raised ($4.5M) as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding an implied valuation of $11M. A peer-median triangulation could not be performed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within narrow valuation tiers—while nine same-sector peers exist, none met the filters required for statistical confidence.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $13M, with a median point of $11M. This range reflects the mechanics of stage progression but carries material uncertainty. Key limitations include reliance on a single methodology, the absence of narrowly-matched peer data, and the broad heterogeneity of climate tech business models. Additional resolution would benefit from: (1) securing revenue or unit economics data to anchor comparability; (2) further fundraising progress that clarifies investor appetite; and (3) identification of more tightly-staged peers in adjacent subsectors.
